> 第573章 使团（第1页）
金袍老者带着上等族群联盟的使团，在镇北城外三里处整整候了两个时辰。
数百位各族族长跪伏于地，衣袍被汗水浸透，却无一人敢动弹分毫。
一名身着玄甲的人族校尉立于城头，朝下望了一眼，声如洪钟宣布道：
随我来，不得喧哗，不得乱走，违者逐出城外。
他起身时双腿微麻，却不敢揉捏，只匆匆整了整衣冠，
便率着身后数百位族长，跟随那名校尉鱼贯入城。
入城之后，金袍老者心中便一直存着一个疑问。
他从方才那名守门将士的口中隐约听出，他们并非第一批抵达的使者团。
敢问将军，我等之前，可已有其他使者团到了？
金袍老者旁边有位上等族群族长，忍不住好奇问道：
金袍老者还有其他族长们便不敢再多问，只是心中愈发好奇。
他们暗暗思忖，莫非是那些离人族疆域较近的中小族群先到了？
金袍老者等联盟使者一路跟着校尉穿过大街小巷，沿途所见，让他微微讶然。
道路两侧果然已有一百多号中小族群的使者候立，每个使者都捧着礼盒。
这些中小族群使者们，见到他们这支上等族群联盟的使团经过，纷纷投来目光。
金袍老者认出其中几个眼熟的族群，萤火族、木族、铁岩族等族群。
都是域外战场上出了名的墙头草，平日最擅长见风使舵。
竟然行动得比我等上等族群联盟还要早。’

正想着，校尉已经带着他们穿过了最后一道城门，来到一片开阔地带。
前方是一座中军大营，营帐连绵，旌旗猎猎，肃杀之气扑面而来。
金袍老者抬头望去，脚下猛然一顿。
他身后那些上等族群的族长们也纷纷停步，
一个个张大了嘴巴，面色变幻不定。
原本还在低声交谈的议论声，在这一刻齐齐安静下来。
只见中军大营的正门之外，最前方一片黑压压的身影伏跪在地。
那些身影身着各色族服，气息各异，有的幽暗如渊，有的璀璨如星，也有的诡谲如雾，或者是圣洁如光。
金袍老者一眼便认出了，那是九大顶级异族的使者团！
鬼族使者居左，通体笼罩在幽暗冥气之中，跪得低垂如伏地之犬。
神族使者居右，往日那不可一世的金色圣光此刻完全收敛。
为首的神族使者额上冷汗涔涔，双手撑地，身形都在颤抖。
灵族使者居中，翠绿色的衣袍在风中低垂如颓败的落叶，再无半分从前的飘逸超然。
冥族、晶族、妖族、星族、狱族等九族使者无一例外，全部跪伏在地。
他们跪成了数排，前后有序，左右分明，显然是被人族将士安置过的位置。
每一排的最前方都跪着各族的正使，身后跟着副使和随从，还有文书官。
这些人曾经每一位都是金袍老者需要仰望的存在。
哪怕是九大异族中的一名普通使者，到了他们这些上等族群的地盘上。
也是趾高气昂、目空一切，连正眼都不屑给一个。
可此刻，那些曾经高高在上的面孔，全部朝着地面，在人族中军大营前方叩拜。

他们额头低垂，脊背躬屈，双手撑在冰冷的土地上，姿态卑微到了极致！

> Chapter 573 Mission (Page 1)
The golden-robed old man led the delegation from the Superior Ethnic Alliance and waited three miles outside Zhenbei City for two hours.
Hundreds of clan leaders were kneeling on the ground, their robes soaked with sweat, but no one dared to move at all.
A human race captain wearing black armor stood at the top of the city, glanced down, and announced in a loud voice:
Come with me, and don't make any noise or walk around. Anyone who violates this rule will be kicked out of the city.
When he stood up, his legs were slightly numb, but he didn't dare to rub them. He only hurriedly adjusted his clothes.
Then he led hundreds of clan leaders behind him and followed the captain into the city.
After entering the city, the golden-robed old man had a question in his mind.
He vaguely heard from the gatekeeper just now that they were not the first group of envoys to arrive.
May I ask General, did other envoys arrive before I waited?
Next to the golden-robed old man was a leader of a superior ethnic group. He couldn't help but asked curiously:
The golden-robed old man and other clan leaders did not dare to ask any more questions, but they became more and more curious.
They secretly wondered, could it be that the small and medium-sized ethnic groups closer to the human race's territory arrived first?
The old man in gold robe and other alliance envoys followed the captain through the streets and alleys. What they saw along the way made him slightly surprised.
As expected, there were more than a hundred envoys from small and medium-sized ethnic groups waiting on both sides of the road, each of them holding a gift box.
When these envoys from the small and medium-sized ethnic groups saw the envoys from the alliance of superior ethnic groups passing by, they all looked at them.
The old man in golden robe recognized several familiar ethnic groups, such as the Yinghuo tribe, the Wood tribe, and the Iron Rock tribe.
They are all well-known outsiders on the battlefield, and they are usually best at adapting to the wind.
They actually acted earlier than me and other superior ethnic group alliances. ’
Just as they were thinking about it, the captain had already led them through the last city gate and arrived at an open area.
In front is a large Chinese army camp, with tents in a row, flags flying, and a murderous atmosphere blowing towards them.
The old man in gold robe looked up and suddenly stopped at his feet.
The patriarchs of the superior ethnic groups behind him also stopped.
All of them opened their mouths, their expressions changing.
The voices that were still chatting in low voices all fell silent at this moment.
Outside the main entrance of the Chinese army camp, a dark figure was seen kneeling on the ground at the front.
Those figures were dressed in various ethnic costumes and had different auras. Some were as dark as an abyss, some were as bright as stars, some were as strange as fog, or some were as holy as light.
The old man in golden robe recognized it at a glance, it was the envoy group of the nine top alien races!
The ghost envoy is on the left, his whole body shrouded in dark aura, and he is kneeling down like a dog lying on the ground.
The envoy of the Gods is on the right, and the golden holy light that was so powerful in the past has completely subsided at this moment.
The leader of the protoss envoy had cold sweat on his forehead, his hands on the ground, and his figure was trembling.
The Spirit Clan envoy was in the middle, his emerald-green robes hanging low in the wind like decadent leaves, no longer as elegant and aloof as before.
The messengers from the Nether Clan, the Crystal Clan, the Monster Clan, the Star Clan, and the Hell Clan all knelt on the ground without exception.
They knelt in several rows, in an orderly manner, with clearly defined left and right sides. They were obviously placed in positions that had been placed by human soldiers.
At the front of each row were kneeling envoys from each clan, followed by deputy envoys and attendants, as well as clerks.
Every one of these people was once a person that the golden-robed old man needed to look up to.
Even if it is an ordinary envoy from the nine foreign races, he has arrived on the territory of these superior races.
He is also arrogant and arrogant, and he doesn't even bother to give him a straight look.
But at this moment, those faces that were once aloof were all facing the ground, bowing in front of the human race's military camp.
Their foreheads were lowered, their backs were bowed, and their hands were resting on the cold earth. Their postures were extremely humble!
